why_not_used_as_control: flyvis T4/T5 direction selectivity is a property of TRAINED networks (Lappalainen et al., Nature 2024).
An untrained connectome-initialised flyvis network would not show direction selectivity, so running it could be mistaken for evidence against the stimuli.
Per the Experiment-18 brief the dependency work was bounded rather than escalated.
